target: Test whether a uniform predecessor/nonloss argument can omit the finite white spatial boundary.
claim_to_test: In any bi-infinite spatial chain of dyadic-periodic temporal profiles obeying c(t+1)=c(t) XOR (a(t) OR b(t)), the last profile determines its predecessor outside periods1/2; no adjacent period drop above2.
method: Enumerate ALL profile pairs at q=2,4,8, retain the indegree/outdegree core (infinite spatial past and future), compare predecessor choices and periods. Root-white reachable graphs are only controls, not used as assumptions.
use: A countermodel kills boundary-free decoder proofs; a positive remains finite evidence and requires a uniform proof.
